implemented.arithmetic: Hoisted invariant client offsets and public powers; unchanged native artifacts and cryptographic equations.
implemented.independent_precomputed_D: Opaque process-local, actor-owned capability binds full context, manifest and exact ciphertext snapshot; full fallback verification remains.
implemented.parallel_prepare_commit: Every verifier performs full independent checks; all references must agree before a signed controller decision and idempotent edge commits.
implemented.profiling: Per-context cumulative successful key-generation and partial-decryption phases plus RPC/encoding nested measurements.
implemented.recovery: Process restart recovery replays decided commits only; pending decisions block new runs and topology changes while allowing original nodes to restart.
